verdict.rationale: Radar Pro explicitly extends beyond checkout to detect multi-account, free-trial, and pay-as-you-go abuse (promo/policy abuse) within the same scoring system (docs-16, docs-6), and reviews/insights let analysts manage related-payment networks (docs-12, docs-19). However, there is no evidence Radar scores or manages account-takeover or fake-account-creation specifically as distinct fraud surfaces — its documented scope centers on payment/transaction risk rather than login or signup-time behavioral risk. missing for 10: explicit account-takeover detection, fake-account-creation scoring, and independent corroboration of these non-payment fraud surfaces.
